in_marathi.name: Manis
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manis हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Manis is derived from the Sanskrit word 'mani', which means 'gem', 'jewel', or 'precious stone'. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Lakshmi, who embodies prosperity, is often depicted holding a lotus filled with precious gems, including manis.
